$comment: The scope of gate-case-counts.sh, kept OUT of the gate so that adding a document to the sweep is a data change a reviewer can see in a diff, not a literal buried mid-script. Measured 2026-09-11 on this tree as it stood before iteration 4 (#111) was merged in: docs/gate-requirements.md cites 23 case counts of the form `N cases` beside the name of a battery, docs/competitive-analysis.md cites 3 more, and nothing executed any of them. In iteration 4 four of those figures went false on a single branch and a fifth expired across two, which is the shape of drift this file exists to end.
$comment_docs: Paths relative to the repository root. A document listed here and absent from disk is exit 2, never a pass: a sweep that quietly skips its own scope is the false green this gate was written against.
$comment_ceiling: A RATCHET, and the half of this gate that stops approval-by-omission. A citation `(N cases)` carrying no `<!-- cases: PATH -->` marker is invisible to the comparison, so an author could add a figure nobody measures and the gate would stay green. It cannot: unmarked citations are counted and compared against this number, and MORE unmarked citations than declared is exit 1.
$comment_why_a_tolerance_at_all: Because eight of the thirty-one citations cannot be marked today, and a gate that demands the impossible gets deleted rather than satisfied. Re-measured 2026-09-11 with iteration 4 merged in, one by one: (a) FOUR citations - gate-requirements.md lines 29, 30, 32 and 46 - name gates whose self-test is inline and prints NO total at all (gate-agent-roster.sh, gate-stage-eval-floor.sh, gate-coverage-gap-claims.sh, gate-negative-proof-census.sh; the last does not even accept --self-test). There is no summary line to read, so marking them would pin them at exit 2 forever. The fix is in those four gates - have their self-test print a total - and it is not this gate's to make. (b) FOUR citations in competitive-analysis.md (lines 122, 727 twice and 834) count dataset rows and bench cases in other people's tools, not battery cases; there is no battery here to run. Line 122 is the one iteration 4 added: the 2,740 cases of OWASP Benchmark v1.2, which a competitor scores against and this repository does not vendor.
$comment_ratchet_only_goes_down: This number goes DOWN when one of those eight becomes measurable, and never up. Raising it is how the hole reopens, so a pull request that raises it is asking a reviewer to approve a figure nobody measures - state the reason here, in this file, where the diff shows it.
$comment_the_cases_now_column: The four counts in the table at gate-requirements.md lines 79-82 are case counts in a column called `Cases now`, written as BARE INTEGERS rather than as `N cases`. They match no citation pattern, so the ratchet above never counted them and nothing measured them - and one of them was already false: measured 2026-09-11, `gate-plugin-integrity.selftest.sh` prints 22, not the 20 that column claimed. They are closed rather than documented: the marker reads the LAST INTEGER before it on the line, which a table cell satisfies without any `N cases` wording, so each of the four rows now carries a marker. Two cases in the battery prove that claim instead of asserting it - a bare integer in a table cell agreeing, and the same cell off by one going red. Note what this does NOT change: those four never matched the citation pattern, so they were never in the unmarked count, and the ceiling above therefore stays at 8 rather than moving. A ceiling that rose here would have been a mistake.
$comment_what_the_iteration_4_merge_did_: Nothing, and that was the work. Merging #111 took the unmarked count from 8 to 16 in one commit, because iteration 4 wrote eight new figures on a branch that did not contain this gate - seven in gate-requirements.md, one in competitive-analysis.md - so nothing could have caught them there. Five were bound to a battery rather than tolerated: gate-errexit-rc-capture, gate-tooling-blindspot, gate-discovery-controls, gate-pack-routing, and a second quotation of the errexit figure that was dropped as a number written twice. One of those five was FALSE the moment it was measured - the row claimed 18 cases where the battery runs 30, being 22 fixture cases and 8 mutants - and gate-pack-routing.selftest.sh had to stop spelling its total `cases: N | ok: M | FAILED: K`, a shape no other file in the tree emits and this gate cannot read, before its figure could be bound at all. Two more went with the paragraph iteration 4 wrote saying these counts are not measured, which this branch had already made untrue. The ninth slot that would otherwise have been needed was paid for by retiring the old (b): the aggregate `59 cases`, whose four addends are each marked and measured in the table directly above it, and which this file admitted was the one hole it left open. It is closed by deleting the sum, not by tolerating it. So the ceiling stays 8 and its composition is 4 + 4 where it was 4 + 1 + 3 - the ratchet did not move, and it did not need to.
$comment_what_the_iteration_6_merge_did_: Nothing, again, and again that was the work. Merging #112 into #113 took the unmarked count from 8 to 10 and CI said so: the `counts` job on 10cd49b reported `10 citation(s) carry no marker, against a declared ceiling of 8`, exit 1. Both new figures were the same number — the 19 cases of gate-deferral-lane.selftest.sh, quoted in its table row and again in the paragraph below it — written on a branch that did not contain this gate, so nothing could have caught them there. Both are now BOUND to that battery rather than tolerated, and binding them surfaced a defect neither review nor the local suite had: the battery spelled its total `Summary: N ok, M failures, K not measured`, a shape no other file here emits and this gate cannot read, and spelled its skipped case `NOT MEASURED <name>`, which the skip reader does not know either. On this Mac the skip never fires and the figure was true; on a runner where root opens a chmod 000 file it fires, and 19 cases would have read as 18 from the same commit. The battery now prints the house shape and a `skip` line, so the size is 19 on both. Ceiling stays 8, composition still 4 + 4.
